_how: Companies whose public job boards the watcher looks for. Edit this to list the companies you care about, then run: python3 -m jobs.boards. names: plain company names; the script guesses each one's Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby board and keeps it only when the name checks out. boards: a company whose board you already know, as name, ats (greenhouse, lever or ashby) and slug (the part of the board link after the system's address). The lists below are a broad starting set (459 companies, 575 known boards). Add or remove companies to fit your search.
